name: Reflect
description: Reflect turns your HR and workforce data into answers, right inside Claude. Ask in plain language and Reflect queries your people analytics directly: headcount, turnover, recruitment, compensation and more, with no export or spreadsheet. It also surfaces the figures behind your legal and compliance reports (BDESE, Egapro index, EU pay transparency). It explores the data catalog you're allowed to see, runs structured analytics queries, and handles advanced SQL when needed. Read-only and secure by design: every request respects your existing Reflect permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Reflect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Reflect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.app.getreflect.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Reflect MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reflect provides these MCP tools: get_query, list_schema, and sql_query.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Reflect?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Reflect in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Reflect requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Reflect is developed by Reflect. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
